name: Kusugurishi Retsuden
source:
Those who give their lives to the cause of tickling are bestowed the title of "Tickleist".

Today, another girl falls victim to the Tickleist's hands...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ255610?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那些为挠痒事业献出生命的人被授予“挠痒痒者”的称号。

今天，另一个女孩成为了痒痒者手中的受害者……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ255610?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
